subject.title: feat(clickclack): session discussions — bound channels, side agent, lifecycle sync

question: Should OpenClaw accept this large bundled ClickClack product and configuration surface, including its shared scoped-session-access contract, as the intended first provider for session discussions?
rationale: The PR introduces a new optional user-facing capability, configuration, remote lifecycle mutations, and a shared authorization seam; this requires owner confirmation beyond patch mechanics.

options.title: Sponsor and complete review
options.body: Accept ClickClack as the initial bundled provider, require contract review plus real after-fix evidence, then address any confirmed findings.

options.title: Narrow to plugin-local work
options.body: Keep the feature in ClickClack but remove or defer shared session-access changes until a smaller documented core contract is approved.

options.title: Defer the provider
options.body: Keep the generic merged discussion seam and postpone this provider until the product and authorization model are explicitly settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and complete review
recommendation.body: Accept ClickClack as the initial bundled provider, require contract review plus real after-fix evidence, then address any confirmed findings.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies steipete as author of both the generic session-discussion seam and this first provider implementation.
